warnings: ST-01 is the stair marked on both S-02 views in bay D-E x 1-2 (grid_ref ~D1, same as the plans). Its only detail is this architectural sheet, extracted because it carries the stair's own members (timber stringers and treads); the plan and section are two views of one stair, so they share this file — same handling as the sibling siamplan house 95 (ST-04).

The sheet carries no grid marker and no level label, so neither the vertical chain (15@0.197 m = 2.95 m) nor the horizontal chain (0.98 + 0.85 = 1.83) can be positioned on the building grid; both stay on the ST-01 element, not in the grid master (section 4 rule 4: a chain touching no known line makes no line).

Stringer and tread sizes are printed in inches (1½" x 8"). width_mm/height_mm are the plain inch-to-mm conversion (38 / 203), printed text kept verbatim. The stringer callout prints no count, so count is null — the plan shows two flights but the number of stringers per flight is not drawn as a mark.
Landing (step 10) height is not printed on the section — not computed into a field.
